posts.author: kidchameleon
posts.body:
Hello. I have managed to create a game over a long amount of time. I had the idea for it in college. I started making it then and went to present day and make the rest of the 66%. It's got a cool story, nice mapping, and decent combat balancing. The plot mainly drives the story, but that's ok, since the plot's pretty cool.
I use RPG Maker 2003 and the mapping is a lot of fun. I wish I could make it with just the maps that came with it, since I haven't done that, I can't make money off of it. But I did manage to make maps using strong tile sets by a bunch of different authors.
The game will most likely take at least 4 hours to about 6 hours for a newbie. This is going off my play: so I don't know how accurate this is.
The story starts with a man who awakens in a bed not remembering his past. He then goes to a nearby town and action starts immediately. You will encounter a number of characters picked upped along the way. The secrets of the main character will be revealed as the story becomes revealed.
The areas in this game vary from forests, to mountains, to caverns, to castles, to villas. Just a lot of good stuff! My mapping skill is one of my best skills while designing a game.
The combat in this game is a lot like ff6 style combat. I even divided the field to look better and be streamlined a bit more.
Some of the challenges the main character faces are from his distant past or stem from his distance past. The title actually works into this.
The overall product is fun (for me) and should come through for the player. Thanks for playing!
Zenith's Remnants by kidchameleon99
#ZR
kidchameleon99.itch.io
More pictures later on!

posts.author: LeetMusic
posts.body: I enjoyed playing through Zenith's Remnants. I especially liked the intrigue surrounding the main character's identity, as well as the nostalgic pixel art and well-designed maps.
